story.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac

draft:
I've been experimenting with the new open-source engine that can run Gemma 4 26B in just 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac. 
This is a significant breakthrough, given the typical memory requirements for such models. 
The implications for AI development on lower-end hardware are substantial. 
Can we expect to see more widespread adoption of AI on edge devices as a result? 
#AI #Macs #OpenSource
